correctness.rationale: Reconstructible enumeration of all 11,393 simplices; exhaustive acyclicity certificate with 5,690 pairs; signed integer Morse boundary has rank 3 and a unit 3-by-3 minor; CW cancellation proves the integral sphere wedge. The rational symmetry module follows from field eigenspaces over primes 97 and 101, both coprime to the group order, with torsion-freeness independently guaranteed and all 32 signed Lefschetz traces matched. The result is finite, not extrapolated.

value.rationale: A complete exact integral homotopy classification for a canonical highly symmetric cubic graph, together with the full dihedral action, distinguishes the ordinary matching complex from its perfect-matching relative and identifies degree-dependent invariant classes.
